Principal, Revenue Advisory

About Litware:

Litware makes billing tools for small software companies. We are a remote-first team spread across the United States.

The role

You will help finance leaders at customer companies plan revenue models, run pricing reviews and explain the numbers to their boards.

  • Lead discovery calls with customer finance teams.
  • Build pricing models in spreadsheets.
  • Partner with sales on renewals.

Requirements

  • 7+ years in finance or revenue operations.
  • Clear written communication.

Pay range: $140,000 - $165,000 base.
